common: Video game art for HAYSTACK, a cozy hidden-object detective game set in Meulebourg, a small French-Belgian town. Strict isometric view (2:1 dimetric, camera at about 30 degrees, no perspective distortion), clean readable shapes that still read well on a phone screen, lots of small details to search through. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no watermark.

diorama.prompt: SUBJECT: an isometric diorama of one street corner of Meulebourg, shown as a square floating block of ground with visible cut sides. Contents: a bakery with a striped pink and white awning and baguettes in the window, two narrow town houses with tiled roofs and shutters, a small square with a round stone fountain, a fruit market stall with a striped awning, a street with a pedestrian crossing, a small retro car, benches, street lamps, trees, flower boxes. About twelve tiny townspeople spread around: a baker woman with a white chef hat and a pink apron in front of the bakery, a police officer with a navy uniform and kepi directing traffic, a tourist with a straw hat and a blue Hawaiian shirt taking a photo, a sneaky thief with a striped black and white shirt, a black beanie and a sack near the market stall, a child with a red balloon, an elderly lady, passers-by. Plain soft background around the block.

personnages.prompt: SUBJECT: a character sheet of four townspeople standing side by side, full body, three-quarter view facing the viewer, same scale, plain light background, generous spacing: (1) a cheerful plump baker woman with a white chef hat, white blouse, pink apron, navy skirt, holding a baguette; (2) a tall police officer with a navy uniform, white gloves and a French kepi, one arm raised to stop traffic; (3) a round-bellied tourist with a straw hat, blue Hawaiian shirt with flowers, beige shorts, sandals, holding a camera; (4) a skinny thief sneaking on tiptoe, black and white striped shirt, black beanie, black eye mask, carrying a sack over the shoulder. Each character must be instantly recognizable by colour and silhouette even when tiny.

batiment.prompt: SUBJECT: a single isometric building game sprite, centered, isolated on a plain flat white background, no ground around it: the Meulebourg bakery, a two-storey town house with a tiled roof and a chimney, a striped pink and white awning over the shop window full of bread and pastries, a wooden door, flower boxes under the upper windows.

styles.style: lush hand-painted anime mobile RPG background art: vegetation everywhere (ivy on walls, moss on roofs, bushes, flowers), soft warm late-afternoon sunlight with gentle god rays, painterly but crisp edges, saturated fresh greens and warm stone colours, small chibi anime characters with big expressive eyes.

cozy painted pixel-art inspired isometric diorama: the block is cut out of the ground showing layers of grass, red brick and grey stone blocks, half-timbered houses with orange tiled roofs, cobblestone paths, conifers and yellow-green trees, crisp chunky shapes with subtle texture, tiny chibi characters.

stylized low-poly 3D render: flat-shaded facets, no outlines, soft global illumination, warm dusk light with glowing lanterns, muted teal water around a sandy pink island with wooden docks and small boats, tiny simple faceless characters, calm and cozy mood.

cute vector illustration with thick dark plum outlines on every shape, saturated candy colours (purple, orange, mint, lime green), cel shading with small white highlights, a floating chunky island diorama with a few tiny floating islets and sparkles around it, round characters with big white eyes and small black pupils, warm tan background.
